report_name: Leaked 'Luna Moth Files' Expose Silent Ransom Group Payments

threat_actors.name: Silent Ransom Group
threat_actors.description: A cyber-extortion group that specializes in targeting law firms using a data-theft-extortion model without encryption. The group uses sophisticated social engineering, including vishing and in-person visits, to gain initial access and exfiltrate sensitive client data for ransom.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion of law firms by threatening to publicly release stolen sensitive client data.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing for Information
attack_patterns.description: The Silent Ransom Group's primary initial access method involves multi-faceted phishing and vishing campaigns to gather information or trick users at law firms.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: The group's social engineering campaigns aim to convince a target to execute a malicious file, which establishes a foothold on their system.

attack_patterns.name: Visual Basic
attack_patterns.description: The Silent Ransom Group (Luna Moth) has been observed using VBS files for execution after gaining initial access to a victim's network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The group's primary goal is data exfiltration, using common protocols to transfer large volumes of stolen data to their own servers.

attack_patterns.name: Financial Theft
attack_patterns.description: The entire operation is a form of financial theft, where payment is extorted under threat of public release of stolen data. One confirmed payment was for $10 million.

identities.name: Fox Rothschild
identities.description: A law firm previously linked as a victim of the Silent Ransom Group.

identities.name: Jones Day
identities.description: A law firm previously linked as a victim of the Silent Ransom Group.

infrastructure.name: SRG Exfiltration Servers
infrastructure.description: Servers used by the Silent Ransom Group to receive large volumes of stolen data exfiltrated from victim networks.

infrastructure.name: The Luna Moth Files Website
infrastructure.description: A mysterious website that leaked internal data allegedly belonging to the Silent Ransom Group.

indicators.name: Suspicious VBS Execution by Office or Browser
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious VBS Execution by Office or Browser
id: 7f5b1a3c-8d9e-4f7a-b1c2-d3e4f5a6b7c8
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of VBS scripts by unusual parent processes like Microsoft Outlook or web browsers, a TTP associated with the Luna Moth group.
references:
  - https://programbusiness.com/news/leaked-data-reveals-millions-in-payments-to-cyber-extortion-group-targeting-law-firms/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the execution of VBS scripts (wscript.exe or cscript.exe) when launched by unusual parent processes such as email clients or web browsers, a known TTP of the Silent Ransom Group.

indicators.name: Visual Basic Script File Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Visual Basic Script File Execution
id: 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-2c1b-a0b1c2d3e4f5
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of Visual Basic scripts (*.vbs), a technique used by the Luna Moth group for execution after initial access.
references:
  - https://programbusiness.com/news/leaked-data-reveals-millions-in-payments-to-cyber-extortion-group-targeting-law-firms/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-10
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative or logon scripts.
tags:
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains: '.vbs'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects process creation events where the command line indicates the execution of a Visual Basic Script (.vbs) file, a technique used by the Silent Ransom Group.
